<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brandGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="316" y1="21" x2="316" y2="26" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="321" y1="19" x2="321" y2="26" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="16" x2="326" y2="26" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="22" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="22" x2="345" y2="22" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="355" y="16" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="357" y="18" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="376" y="19" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,64 23,72 31,80" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="78" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Account settings</text>
    <line x1="18" y1="101" x2="372" y2="101" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Page heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="147" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Phone number</text>
    <text x="24" y="174" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your phone number is verified</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Success notification -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="198" width="350" height="74" rx="14" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="235" r="18" fill="#96E063"/>
    <polyline points="43,235 49,241 61,228" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="82" y="230" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15px" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">Number verified</text>
    <text x="82" y="251" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your account is protected with SMS verification.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Verified field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="316" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">VERIFIED PHONE NUMBER</text>
    <rect x="20" y="330" width="350" height="62" rx="10" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="361" r="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#96E063" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="43,361 48,366 56,356" fill="none" stroke="#96E063" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="76" y="367" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">+1 (415) 555-0186</text>
    <text x="24" y="418" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Verified on July 24, 2026</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Update section -->
  <g>
    <line x1="20" y1="451" x2="370" y2="451" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="24" y="491" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Need to change your number?</text>
    <text x="24" y="518" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Update it to keep your account secure and reachable.</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="24" y="550" width="342" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
      <text x="195" y="578" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">UPDATE PHONE NUMBER</text>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="628" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Why do we need your number?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="738" width="390" height="106" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="738" x2="390" y2="738" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Discover -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="39" cy="771" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="39" cy="771" r="3" fill="#939393"/>
      <text x="39" y="804" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Likes -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="136" cy="771" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="130,771 134,775 142,767" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="136" y="804" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Chats -->
    <g>
      <rect x="216" y="762" width="23" height="17" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="220,779 220,784 226,779" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="228" y="804" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Chats</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile active -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="331" cy="766" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="331" cy="780" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="343" cy="759" r="4" fill="#FE3675"/>
      <text x="331" y="804" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <rect x="145" y="830" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
